name: no-false-failover
description: SIMULATED SETTING, not a measurement: link delays are configured so that A-B and B-C (10 ms one way) are cheaper than A-D and D-C (25 ms one way). Two consecutive link-layer failures to B (K-1 with K=3) happen three times, each separated by successes. T2 must not trigger and no failover happens. (The false-trigger rate under random loss is measured with --false-triggers.)
